product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Gold Globe Table Lamp 22" H, Integrated LED Light
product.description: Bring chic vibes with the eye-catching opal globe piece that is sure to bring style. Boldly designed and glamourous, yet functional, you'll never have to replace bulbs since Integrated LEDs are included, instead the piece will be starting striking conversations for you. 12.5" W x 7.75" D x 22" H Metal in a satin brass (gold) plated finish with a white opal globe shade made of durable ABS On/off touch switch on base, perfect for an office, living room, or bedroom Energy Efficient Integrated LED technology, saving you time and money, no bulbs to replace
